## Read in old sites

```{r}

g2g_output_2018_2022 <- load.g2g.data(dates = c(2018, 2021), sufi = TRUE)
obs_ts <- g2g_output_2018_2022$obs
mod_ts <- g2g_output_2018_2022$mod
## read in the events
events <- fread("../data/notable_events.csv")
events_pre_2022 <- events[Year <= 2021,]
## read in the catchment metadata
catchments <- fread("../data/cdata/catchment_cdata_EA-NRW.csv", fill = Inf)
## filter by wales
wales <- st_read("../data/SENC_MAY_2026_WA_BFC_-1059615406868623242/SENC_MAY_2026_WA_BFC.shp")
wales <- st_transform(wales, 27700)

## extract catchments (note this is whole uk)
catchments_sf <- st_as_sf(
  catchments,
  coords = c("WISKI.EASTING", "WISKI.NORTHING"),
  crs = 27700,
  remove = FALSE
)## use wiski easting and northing for precise coords
wales_poly <- st_union(wales) ## combine with wales
sf_g2g_ids <- unique(c(catchments_sf[st_intersects(catchments_sf, wales_poly, sparse = FALSE), ]$G2G.ID, catchments[Region. == "Wales"]$G2G.ID)) ## use both ids coded as Wales, plus anything inside the polygon
wales_cdata <- catchments[G2G.ID %in% sf_g2g_ids]## this is the old catchment data sheet



```


## Read in new sites

```{r}

g2g_new_sites_metadata <- fread("../data/new_g2g_sites_g2g_coords.csv", fill= Inf)

obs_dir <-  "../data/g2g_data/observed_new_sites"
```

## make events

```{r}

events <- fread("../data/notable_events.csv")
events_pre_2022 <- events[Year <= 2021,]

events_list_og <- make.events.list(mod_ts, obs_ts, events_pre_2022, cdata = wales_cdata, region.classifier =  NULL, exclude.non.notable.sites = FALSE)

events_list_new <- make.events.list(mod_new, obs_new, events_pre_2022, cdata = g2g_new_sites_metadata, region.classifier =  NULL, exclude.non.notable.sites = FALSE)


qt_grid_paths <- mixedsort(sort(file.path("../data/qt_grids", list.files("../data/qt_grids")))) ## create relative paths
qt_val <- sub("_.*", "", mixedsort(sort(list.files("../data/qt_grids"))))
qt_grid_list <- lapply(qt_grid_paths, read.ascii)
names(qt_grid_list) <- qt_val ## name by qt
qt_dt_old <- make.qt.csv(qt_grid_list, cdata = wales_cdata, write = FALSE)
qt_dt_old[, Site:= NULL]
qt_dt_new <- make.qt.csv(qt_grid_list, cdata = g2g_new_sites_metadata, write = FALSE)

qt_dt <- rbind(qt_dt_old, qt_dt_new) ## new combined qt data for new and old sites
# fwrite(qt_dt, "../data/g2g_qt_old_new_sites_added.csv")

setnames(g2g_new_sites_metadata, "ac_catchmentsize_g2g", "CATCHMENTSIZE")
wales_cdata <- wales_cdata[,.(G2G.ID, G2G.Easting, G2G.Northing, CATCHMENTSIZE)]
g2g_new_sites_metadata <- g2g_new_sites_metadata[,.(G2G.ID, G2G.Easting, G2G.Northing, CATCHMENTSIZE)]

## combine cdata metadata
complete_metadata <- rbind(wales_cdata, g2g_new_sites_metadata)

```


## QT MED PODFAR

```{r}

# max_discharge_ <- list()

#   })
# }

max_discharge_new <- lapply(events_list_new, extract.peak.discharge)

max_discharge_og <- lapply(events_list_og, lapply,extract.peak.discharge)



qmed_old <-qt_dt_old[, .(G2G.ID, qmed)]$qmed
names(qmed_old) <- qt_dt_old$G2G.ID
qmed_new <-qt_dt_new[, .(G2G.ID, qmed)]$qmed
names(qmed_new) <- qt_dt_new$G2G.ID


qmed_pod_far_tol_og <- lapply(max_discharge_og, lapply, pod.far.tol, threshold = qmed_old)
qmed_pod_far_tol_new <- lapply(max_discharge_new,  pod.far.tol, threshold = qmed_new)



qmed_pod_far_tol_og <- lapply(qmed_pod_far_tol_og, lapply, merge, y = complete_metadata, by = "G2G.ID")
qmed_pod_far_tol_new <- lapply(qmed_pod_far_tol_new, merge, y = complete_metadata, by = "G2G.ID")

qmed_pod_far_tol_dt_og <- lapply(qmed_pod_far_tol_og, rbindlist, idcol = "Storm")
qmed_pod_far_tol_dt_new <- rbindlist(qmed_pod_far_tol_new, idcol = "Storm")

qmed_pod_far_tol_dt_combined <- lapply(qmed_pod_far_tol_dt_og, function(og_dt) {
  rbindlist(list(Old = og_dt, New = qmed_pod_far_tol_dt_new), idcol = "Version", fill = TRUE)
})


```

## CSI (qmed exceedance) plot new vs old sites

```{r}

create.csi.plot <- function(dt, wales, cdata, lenient = FALSE, status_col = "Version"){
  
  by_cols <- c("G2G.ID", "outcome", status_col)
  site_counts <- dt[, .N, by = mget(by_cols)]
  
  dcast_formula <- as.formula(paste("G2G.ID +", status_col, "~ outcome"))
  site_counts_wide <- dcast(site_counts, dcast_formula, value.var = "N", fill = 0)

  required_cols <- c("hit", "near miss", "miss", "false alarm")
  for (col in required_cols) {
    if (!col %in% names(site_counts_wide)) {
      site_counts_wide[, (col) := 0]
    }
  }

  site_counts_wide[, CSI_strict := hit / (hit + miss + `false alarm`)] ## strict csi
  site_counts_wide[, CSI_lenient := (hit + `near miss`) / (hit + `near miss` + miss + `false alarm`)] ## lenient csi
  
  # site_counts_wide[is.nan(CSI_strict), CSI_strict := 0]
  # site_counts_wide[is.nan(CSI_lenient), CSI_lenient := 0]

  # if else for which csi is chosen as arg
  if (!lenient) {
    site_counts_wide[, CSI := CSI_strict]
  } else {
    site_counts_wide[, CSI := CSI_lenient]
  }

  plot_data <- merge(
    site_counts_wide,
    cdata[, .(G2G.ID, G2G.Easting, G2G.Northing, CATCHMENTSIZE)],
    by = "G2G.ID",
    all.x = TRUE
  )
  
  # filter out any missing coordinates or CSI values
  plot_data <- plot_data[!is.na(G2G.Easting) & !is.na(CSI)]

  setnames(plot_data, status_col, "Site_Status")

  p <- ggplot() +
    geom_sf(data = wales, fill = "#e9ecef", color = "#495057", linewidth = 0.5) +
    
    geom_point(
      data = plot_data,
      aes(
        x = G2G.Easting,
        y = G2G.Northing,
        size = CATCHMENTSIZE,
        fill = CSI,
        shape = factor(Site_Status)
      ),
      color = "black",   
      stroke = 0.8,      
      alpha = 0.95
    ) +
    coord_sf(datum = 27700) +
    
    # CSI viridis color scale (0 to 1)
    scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "viridis", limits = c(0, 1)) +
    
    # Fillable shapes: 21 = Circle, 24 = Triangle
    scale_shape_manual(values = c(25, 21)) +
    
    # Catchment size point scaling
    scale_size_continuous(range = c(2, 8)) +
    
    # Legend labels
    labs(
      fill  = if (lenient) "CSI (Lenient)" else "CSI (Strict)",
      shape = "Site Type",
      size  = expression("Catchment size (" * km^2 * ")")
    ) +
    
    # Solid, crisp theme (high contrast, white backgrounds)
    theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      plot.background   = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      panel.background  = element_rect(fill = "#f8f9fa", color = "black"),
      legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "gray80"),
      legend.key        = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major  = element_line(color = "gray90", linetype = "dotted"),
      panel.grid.minor  = element_blank(),
      axis.text         = element_blank(),
      axis.title        = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks        = element_blank()
    )

  return(p)
}



sufi_csi_qmed <- create.csi.plot(qmed_pod_far_tol_dt_combined$sufi, wales = wales, cdata = complete_metadata, lenient = FALSE)

sufi_csi_qmed_lenient <- create.csi.plot(qmed_pod_far_tol_dt_combined$sufi, wales = wales, cdata = complete_metadata, lenient = TRUE)


sim_csi_qmed <- create.csi.plot(qmed_pod_far_tol_dt_combined$sim, wales = wales, cdata = complete_metadata, lenient = FALSE)

sim_csi_qmed_lenient <- create.csi.plot(qmed_pod_far_tol_dt_combined$sim, wales = wales, cdata = complete_metadata, lenient = TRUE)

sim_csi_qmed +sim_csi_qmed_lenient + plot_annotation(title = "SIM")

sufi_csi_qmed +sufi_csi_qmed_lenient + plot_annotation(title = "SUFI")



```



```{r}



dt_sim  <- qmed_pod_far_tol_dt_combined$sim
dt_sufi <- qmed_pod_far_tol_dt_combined$sufi

plot_dt <- rbindlist(list(
dt_sufi[Version == "New", .(Version = "New", Storm, outcome)],
dt_sim[Version == "Old",  .(Version = "sim Old", Storm, outcome)],
dt_sufi[Version == "Old", .(Version = "sufi Old", Storm, outcome)]
))

plot_dt[, Version := factor(Version, levels = c("New", "sim Old", "sufi Old"))]

plot_dt[, outcome := factor(
outcome,
levels = c(
  "miss" ,              # Top
  "false alarm",
  "close false alarm",
  "missing data",
  "near miss",
  "correct rejection",
  "hit"               # Top
)
)]

#3 bar plot
p <- ggplot(plot_dt[!is.na(outcome)], aes(x = Version, fill = outcome)) +
geom_bar(position = "fill", color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
facet_wrap(~ Storm) +
scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(), expand = c(0, 0)) +
scale_fill_manual(
  values = c(
    "hit"               = "#2b83ba",  # Vibrant Blue
    "correct rejection" = "#cccccc",  # Neutral Gray
    "near miss"         = "#abdda4",  # Soft Light Green
    "missing data"      = "#808080",  # Medium Gray
    "close false alarm" = "#fee08b",  # Light Yellow / Gold
    "false alarm"       = "#fdae61",  # Orange
    "miss"              = "#d7191c"   # Deep Red
  ),
  drop = FALSE
) +
labs(
  title = "Outcome Breakdown by Storm Event",
  subtitle = "Comparing performance across New, sim Old, and sufi Old setups",
  x = "Site Version",
  y = "Percentage of Total Outcomes",
  fill = "Outcome"
) +
theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
theme(
  plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
  legend.position = "top",
  axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1) # Angle labels so text doesn't overlap
)

p
```


### Split plots by catchment size

```{r}

dt_sim  <- copy(qmed_pod_far_tol_dt_combined$sim)
dt_sufi <- copy(qmed_pod_far_tol_dt_combined$sufi)

plot_dt <- rbindlist(list(
  dt_sufi[Version == "New", .(G2G.ID, CATCHMENTSIZE, Version = "New", Storm, outcome)],
  dt_sim[Version == "Old",  .(G2G.ID, CATCHMENTSIZE, Version = "sim Old", Storm, outcome)],
  dt_sufi[Version == "Old", .(G2G.ID, CATCHMENTSIZE, Version = "sufi Old", Storm, outcome)]
))

plot_dt[, Version := factor(Version, levels = c("New", "sim Old", "sufi Old"))]
plot_dt[, outcome := factor(
  outcome,
levels = c(
  "miss" ,              # Top
  "false alarm",
  "close false alarm",
  "missing data",
  "near miss",
  "correct rejection",
  "hit"               # Top
)
)]

small  <- plot_dt[CATCHMENTSIZE < 100]
medium <- plot_dt[CATCHMENTSIZE >= 100 & CATCHMENTSIZE < 500]
large  <- plot_dt[CATCHMENTSIZE >= 500]

n_small_new      <- length(unique(small[Version == "New"]$G2G.ID))
n_small_sim_old  <- length(unique(small[Version == "sim Old"]$G2G.ID))
n_small_sufi_old <- length(unique(small[Version == "sufi Old"]$G2G.ID))

n_med_new        <- length(unique(medium[Version == "New"]$G2G.ID))
n_med_sim_old    <- length(unique(medium[Version == "sim Old"]$G2G.ID))
n_med_sufi_old   <- length(unique(medium[Version == "sufi Old"]$G2G.ID))

n_large_new      <- length(unique(large[Version == "New"]$G2G.ID))
n_large_sim_old  <- length(unique(large[Version == "sim Old"]$G2G.ID))
n_large_sufi_old <- length(unique(large[Version == "sufi Old"]$G2G.ID))

outcome_colors <- c(
  "hit"               = "#2b83ba",  
  "correct rejection" = "#cccccc",  
  "near miss"         = "#abdda4",  
  "missing data"      = "#808080",  
  "close false alarm" = "#fee08b",  
  "false alarm"       = "#fdae61",  
  "miss"              = "#d7191c"   
)


small_plot <- ggplot(small, aes(x = Version, fill = outcome)) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill", color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
  facet_wrap(~ Storm) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = outcome_colors, drop = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = paste0("Outcome Breakdown by Storms:\n SMALL SITES (<100km2) | n New: ", n_small_new, " | n sim Old: ", n_small_sim_old, " | n sufi Old: ", n_small_sufi_old),
    subtitle = "Comparing performance across New, sim Old, and sufi Old setups",
    x = "Site Version",
    y = "Percentage of Total Outcomes",
    fill = "Outcome"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "top",
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1)
  )


medium_plot <- ggplot(medium, aes(x = Version, fill = outcome)) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill", color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
  facet_wrap(~ Storm) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = outcome_colors, drop = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = paste0("Outcome Breakdown by Storms:\n MEDIUM SITES (100-500km2) | n New: ", n_med_new, " | n sim Old: ", n_med_sim_old, " | n sufi Old: ", n_med_sufi_old),
    subtitle = "Comparing performance across New, sim Old, and sufi Old setups",
    x = "Site Version",
    y = "Percentage of Total Outcomes",
    fill = "Outcome"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "top",
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1)
  )


large_plot <- ggplot(large, aes(x = Version, fill = outcome)) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill", color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
  facet_wrap(~ Storm) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = outcome_colors, drop = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = paste0("Outcome Breakdown by Storms:\n LARGE SITES (>500km2) | n New: ", n_large_new, " | n sim Old: ", n_large_sim_old, " | n sufi Old: ", n_large_sufi_old),
    subtitle = "Comparing performance across New, sim Old, and sufi Old setups",
    x = "Site Version",
    y = "Percentage of Total Outcomes",
    fill = "Outcome"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "top",
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1)
  )
```
